notes: Estimates are incremental given parents already ran. Actual spend depends on history chunking and retries. Scope (Alpha/Spot gate) always runs first.

modules.name: Pre-listing insider tree
modules.what: Mint from 0x0, deployer outflows before Alpha listing, quiet vs already-moved receivers.

modules.name: Top holders + labels
modules.what: Point-in-time top-50 balances with Arkham entity labels.

modules.name: 72h large transfers
modules.what: Transfers of >=100k tokens in the last ~4 days, with tx hashes.

modules.name: Liquidity / 5% entry cap
modules.what: Main pool, 24h LP flow, Alpha 5% depth heuristic for position size.

modules.name: CEX perp tier (S1/S2/S3)
modules.what: Binance/Aster/Bitget perp listing. No Surf SQL.

modules.name: TGE / LP first transfer
modules.what: First pool transfer vs Alpha listing time.

modules.name: Chip / role mix
modules.what: Role buckets (pool, deployer, quiet, dumper dest, other) plus alloc rows.

modules.name: Confirmed DEX/CEX sell-out
modules.what: Insider tree tokens sold on DEX or sent to labelled CEX deposits.

modules.name: Funding source (mint vs DEX vs P2P)
modules.what: Where high-value wallets received tokens: 0x0 mint, DEX buy, or P2P.

modules.name: High-throughput dumpers
modules.what: Wallets that took a large allocation, ~cleared it, with high tx count.

modules.name: CEX fan-out hubs
modules.what: CEX hot wallet → hub → many sub-wallets.

modules.name: Wallet clusters
modules.what: Wallets that look retail but transfer among themselves.

modules.name: 72h fan-out vs CEX consolidation
modules.what: Operator seeding many EOAs, or many EOAs dumping into CEX, last 3 days.

modules.name: Monitoring wallet export
modules.what: Deduped wallet list from whatever modules ran. No extra SQL.

modules.name: Wash-infra (advanced)
modules.what: Closed-loop wash detection. Expensive; off by default.

modules.name: Cross-token whales (advanced)
modules.what: Same wallet in top holders of many Alpha tokens. Often routers/MEV.

modules.name: Flow operators (advanced)
modules.what: Sandwich / MEV-style flow operators. Off by default.
